attributes.name: Karelian Bear Dog
attributes.description: The Karelian Bear Dog is a medium-sized breed that originated in Finland. They have a thick, double coat, and come in a variety of colors. They are an active and energetic breed, and need plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. They are loyal and devoted to their owners, and make good family companions. They are also excellent guard dogs, and are known for their bravery and courage.
